options_evaluated: Co-molded multi-material plastics with metallic coatings
assessments.rationale: Monomaterial unpainted plastics significantly improve the ease and quality of recycling (Parameter d, Page 79) and avoid technical solutions detrimental to material recovery (Parameter e, Page 79). Co-molded plastics and composites introduce contaminants that prevent high-quality recycling, increase the amounts of waste generated (Parameter r, Page 80), and release microplastics/nanoplastics during mechanical shredding at end-of-life (Parameter p, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design and Manufacturing stages, which may prefer fiberglass-reinforced composites for higher mechanical strength, thinner walls, and lightweighting, or metallic coatings for premium aesthetics.

assessments.rationale: Reversible fasteners facilitate easy disassembly and re-assembly, which is crucial for the ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment (Parameter c, Page 27, 79). This choice directly avoids technical solutions detrimental to end-of-life recovery (Parameter e, Page 79) and ensures components can be separated cleanly to maximize recycling quality (Parameter d, Page 79) while minimizing waste generation (Parameter r, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, which typically favors permanent ultrasonic welding or chemical adhesives to minimize assembly time, reduce bill-of-materials cost, and achieve tighter dust/water seals.

options_evaluated: Integrated brushless DC motor with glued-in rare earth magnets
Modular brushless DC motor with mechanically secured, easily separable magnets
assessments.recommendation: Modular brushless DC motor with mechanically secured, easily separable magnets
assessments.rationale: A modular design with mechanically secured magnets supports the ease of remanufacturing and refurbishment (Parameter c, Page 27, 79). It avoids solutions detrimental to recovery (Parameter e, Page 79) by enabling the clean, damage-free separation of high-value rare earth magnets and copper windings, thereby enhancing the ease and quality of recycling (Parameter d, Page 79) and reducing hazardous waste (Parameter r, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, due to the increased assembly complexity and higher initial cost of mechanical retention systems compared to simple gluing.

options_evaluated: Removable and washable thermal filters and heatsinks
Potted/glued thermal compounds on the motor housing
assessments.recommendation: Removable and washable thermal filters and heatsinks
assessments.rationale: Removable components prevent the contamination of plastics and metals during end-of-life processing, avoiding solutions detrimental to recycling and recovery (Parameter e, Page 79). Potted or overmolded materials cannot be easily separated, which degrades the ease and quality of recycling (Parameter d, Page 79), increases the environmental footprint in end-of-life treatment (Parameter m, Page 33, 80), and generates more residual waste (Parameter r, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Performance and Use stages, which may favor potted thermal compounds for superior heat dissipation, compact design, and better vibration/noise dampening.

options_evaluated: Fully modular architecture with easily swappable sub-assemblies (motor, cord reel, battery pack)
Semi-modular architecture with some soldered components
assessments.recommendation: Fully modular architecture with easily swappable sub-assemblies (motor, cord reel, battery pack)
assessments.rationale: A fully modular architecture directly enhances the ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment (Parameter c, Page 27, 79). It prevents the premature disposal of the entire vacuum cleaner when only a single component fails, thereby avoiding solutions detrimental to reuse (Parameter e, Page 79) and drastically reducing the amounts of waste generated (Parameter r, Page 14, 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design and Aesthetics, as modularity often requires more internal space, resulting in a bulkier, heavier product and higher initial material use.

options_evaluated: Cordless with user-replaceable modular battery pack
Cordless with integrated, non-replaceable battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Cordless with user-replaceable modular battery pack
assessments.rationale: A user-replaceable modular battery pack ensures that the battery can be easily swapped out for refurbishment or sent to dedicated battery recycling streams (Parameter c, Page 27, 79; Parameter d, Page 79). This avoids the highly detrimental scenario where an integrated battery fails and forces the disposal of the entire appliance (Parameter e, Page 79), which would otherwise generate massive amounts of electronic and hazardous waste (Parameter r, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (users might prefer integrated batteries for a lighter, more seamless design) and Manufacturing stage (due to the added cost of battery housing and contact interfaces).
